verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents documents first-class MCP server support on a dedicated docs page: you wrap an MCP server in an `MCPToolset` and pass it to the agent's `tools` parameter. The GitHub README separately advertises native MCP support that integrates MCP-server tools with one line of code. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that MCP tool integration works, and evidence on supported transports (stdio/HTTP) and auth or configuration details.
